title: Work Backward and Use Examples
learningObjectives: Explain working backward as a problem-solving strategy.
Use small examples to understand requirements and behavior.
Apply inverse reasoning to a simple sequence.
Verify a proposed approach against multiple cases.

understand.concept: Working backward starts from a desired outcome and reasons toward the conditions or steps needed to reach it. Small examples simplify a problem so its behavior can be checked manually. Counterexamples test whether an assumption holds in all relevant cases.
understand.whyItMatters: Reverse reasoning can reveal missing dependencies, while examples and counterexamples help test ideas before implementation becomes complex.
understand.analogy: Planning a trip backward from arrival time to determine when to leave and what must be prepared.
understand.analogyLimit: A few examples do not prove a general rule; test diverse cases and use formal reasoning where correctness matters.

explain.narrative: State the target result, identify the final operation or condition, and reason about what must have been true immediately before it. Use small values to verify the idea. Try a counterexample or boundary case that could challenge the assumption, then refine the approach.

examples.explanation: Undoing the last operation helps find an earlier state.

examples.title: Use a counterexample
examples.explanation: A zero input can disprove an assumption that all inputs are positive.

commonMistakes: Working backward without a clear target.
Using only one example and assuming it proves the rule.
Undoing operations in the wrong order.

guidedTask.title: Guided practice: Find the starting value
guidedTask.instructions: A sequence adds 8 and then doubles a number to produce 30. Work backward to find the starting value.
steps: Undo the final doubling by dividing by 2.
Check the starting value by running the original sequence forward.
Try a different final value and repeat.
guidedTask.starterCode: // Use reverse steps and verify with a forward check; no playground is required.

independentTask.title: Independent practice: Reverse a multi-step calculation
independentTask.instructions: Work backward from a target in a small calculation chain.
requirements: Choose a final target value and operations.
Undo the operations in reverse order.
Verify by applying the original operations forward.
Test a counterexample or boundary value.

hints: Use small values to reduce arithmetic mistakes.
Verify by replaying the original steps.
Try a value that might break your assumption.
